CustomField.description: Emergency response a commercial site gets from its site type. Keep in step with RLM_HVAC_CommercialPricing.responseSku.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(RLM_HVAC_Site_Type__c, "Restaurant"), ISPICKVAL(RLM_HVAC_Site_Type__c, "Data Room")), "4 hours, 24/7", IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_HVAC_Site_Type__c)) || ISPICKVAL(RLM_HVAC_Site_Type__c, "Headquarters"), "", "Next business day"))
CustomField.label: Response Tier
